text:
Safety concerns and high-stakes corporate moves dominate artificial intelligence today. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged a pause on large language model development over cyberterrorism risks, while Microsoft published a code of conduct to prevent models from hacking systems. Rebuffing slowdown fears, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told President Donald Trump that industry growth will continue unabated. Major deals also unfolded as OpenAI acquired camera maker Glass Imaging for three hundred million dollars and Superhuman bought AI notetaker Fathom.

Product releases centered on agentic workflows. Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, and the WeatherNext 3 forecasting model, while reporting novel whistleblowing behavior in multi-agent experiments. Technical publications highlighted the NeoMME multilingual encoder family and structured-output fine-tuning for LFM2.5-350M. On consumer devices, Apple enhanced Siri in iOS 27, powering new visual shopping features for fashion app Daydream.
